+"""Standalone mark normalization that skips ``None`` entries.
+
+This module intentionally has no dependency on pytest so that it stays
+importable without pytest or its mark registry.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+from typing import Any
+
+
+__all__ = ["normalize_nonempty_marks"]
+
+
+def normalize_nonempty_marks(
+    Mark: type | tuple[type, ...],
+    mark_list: Iterable[Any],
+) -> Iterator[Any]:
+    """
+    Normalize an iterable of Mark or MarkDecorator objects into marks
+    by retrieving the `mark` attribute on MarkDecorator instances,
+    skipping literal ``None`` entries.
+
+    :param Mark: the type (or tuple of types) valid marks must be instances of
+    :param mark_list: marks to normalize
+    :returns: A generator of the extracted Mark objects
+    """
+    for mark in mark_list:
+        if mark is None:
+            continue
+        mark_obj = getattr(mark, "mark", mark)
+        if not isinstance(mark_obj, Mark):
+            raise TypeError(f"got {mark_obj!r} instead of Mark")
+        yield mark_obj

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import ModuleType
+
+import pytest
+
+
+MODULE_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_skip_empty_marks.py"
+
+
+def _load_module() -> ModuleType:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_skip_empty_marks", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+normalize_nonempty_marks = _load_module().normalize_nonempty_marks
+
+
+class FakeMark:
+    def __init__(self, name: str) -> None:
+        self.name = name
+
+
+class FakeDecorator:
+    def __init__(self, mark: object) -> None:
+        self.mark = mark
+
+
+def test_returns_generator() -> None:
+    result = normalize_nonempty_marks(FakeMark, [])
+    assert iter(result) is result
+    assert list(result) == []
+
+
+def test_extracts_marks_and_decorators() -> None:
+    a, b = FakeMark("a"), FakeMark("b")
+    assert list(normalize_nonempty_marks(FakeMark, [a, FakeDecorator(b)])) == [a, b]
+
+
+def test_skips_none_entries() -> None:
+    a, b = FakeMark("a"), FakeMark("b")
+    marks = [None, a, None, FakeDecorator(b), None]
+    assert list(normalize_nonempty_marks(FakeMark, marks)) == [a, b]
+    assert list(normalize_nonempty_marks(FakeMark, [None, None])) == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", [1, "mark", FakeDecorator(None), FakeDecorator(2)])
+def test_invalid_raises_type_error(bad: object) -> None:
+    expected = getattr(bad, "mark", bad)
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match=r"^got .* instead of Mark$") as excinfo:
+        list(normalize_nonempty_marks(FakeMark, [None, bad]))
+    assert str(excinfo.value) == f"got {expected!r} instead of Mark"
+
+
+def test_lazy_evaluation() -> None:
+    a = FakeMark("a")
+    gen = normalize_nonempty_marks(FakeMark, [a, None, 1])
+    assert next(gen) is a
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        next(gen)
+
+
+def test_matches_real_mark_types() -> None:
+    from _pytest.mark.structures import Mark
+    from _pytest.mark.structures import MarkDecorator
+    from _pytest.mark.structures import normalize_mark_list
+
+    marks: list[Mark | MarkDecorator] = [
+        pytest.mark.foo,
+        Mark("bar", (), {}, _ispytest=True),
+        pytest.mark.baz(1),
+    ]
+    assert list(normalize_nonempty_marks(Mark, [None, *marks])) == list(
+        normalize_mark_list(marks)
+    )
+
+
+def test_does_not_import_pytest() -> None:
+    tree = ast.parse(MODULE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported: set[str] = set()
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            imported.update(alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module:
+            imported.add(node.module.split(".")[0])
+    assert not imported & {"pytest", "_pytest"}

Copied normalize_mark_list control flow into a pytest-free generator taking Mark as an injected isinstance target, adding a single skip of literal None entries before attribute extraction/validation. Tests load the module by file path and compare against the real normalize_mark_list.
